depth_justification: A few questions touch this app (radiologist autonomy as second-reader, imaging-equipment variation across 30 EU hospitals, calibrated-probability interpretation) but it recycles the same [P2.D3] tag, ignores the developer's substantive answers (prospective N=4500, AUROC 0.96, +4% reader accuracy), and the user is forced to repeat the same reply turn after turn.
actionability_justification: Every assistant turn is a single reflection question with zero recommendations, and when explicitly asked to produce a structured risk report it replies with yet another question, delivering nothing implementable.
salient_examples: Assistant only ever asks: 'What measures are in place to ensure that CareAir's AI does not introduce false positives...? [P7.D1]'
User repeats 'Vision Transformer trained on ~1M chest X-rays. Calibrated probabilities...' three times because answers are ignored
After 'Could you produce a brief structured risk report now?' the reply is another question, not a report
Same [P2.D3] tag reused across multiple distinct questions
